scope: Target families, not the original provider/tool catalog. Recipe coverage is not engine or behavioral parity.

families.name: Native Mach-O, ELF, PE and DOS
families.required: Architecture-correct decompilation, symbols, xrefs, call/value flow, original addresses and provider lifecycle
families.gap: No real Ghidra, IDA or Hopper engine comparison; plain command output does not populate native relationship views.

families.name: Offline ELF layout
families.required: Sections, segments, symbols, relocations, static mitigations and partial coverage
families.gap: No matched pwntools/binutils fixture lane on the supported Linux host.

families.name: EVM bytecode
families.required: Raw/hex carriers, PUSH offsets, dispatch selectors and qualified argument/mutability inference
families.gap: No matched offline dispatch or malformed-bytecode lane.

families.name: Recorded Linux crashes
families.required: All recorded threads, register/signal notes and identity-qualified mappings
families.gap: No matched Linux core fixture, pwntools or GDB lane.

families.name: JavaScript and Electron
families.required: Packages, modules, imports, source maps, IPC/native boundaries, relationship graphs and unresolved expressions
families.gap: Two static fixture probes cover entrypoint, one IPC literal and source digest. AST graphs, source maps, dynamic boundaries and runtime capture remain unverified.

families.name: Websites
families.required: Selected page/actions, scripts, DOM/accessibility, network, screenshots and owned browser lifecycle
families.gap: Installed-host workbench rendering is not target website capture. No matched browser scenario execution lane.

families.name: Saved network captures
families.required: HAR/mitmproxy producer identities, payload bytes, source pointers, redaction and malformed/partial cases
families.gap: One public HAR fixture matches URL, HTTP status and text. Canonical network projection, secrets and mitmproxy remain unverified.

families.name: .NET assemblies
families.required: Metadata/member identities, CIL offsets, native boundaries and build comparisons
families.gap: Original has built-in static inspection. App recipes require an installed metadata/decompiler utility; no equivalent managed lane has been established.

families.name: Android APK code
families.required: Manifest/classes, methods, references and decompiler failures on the supported host
families.gap: No configured JADX/JDK fixture comparison; ZIP inventory alone is insufficient.

families.name: Android devices
families.required: Explicit serial, packages/processes/logs/dumps, captures and exact transfer destinations
families.gap: No selected device or adb acceptance lane; read-only recipes do not prove device behavior.

families.name: JEB projects
families.required: Selected project/unit IDs, digests, type/method pseudocode and read-only attachment
families.gap: No selected running JEB endpoint or engine comparison.

families.name: Android resources
families.required: Decoded manifest, resource identities, string tables, locales and version facts
families.gap: No configured Apktool/JDK comparison; binary XML cannot be replaced by text searching.

families.name: Firmware
families.required: Region coordinates, extraction integrity/limits and native handoffs
families.gap: No supported-host binwalk/unblob lane or matched extraction fixture.

families.name: Packages and Apple resources
families.required: Inventories/digests, plists, bundle anatomy, keyed archives and asset resources
families.gap: ASAR source extraction covers one package format only; Apple and broader archive semantics remain unverified.

families.name: Process behavior
families.required: Terminal interactions, exit/filesystem observations, canonical captures and comparisons
families.gap: Owned pipe execution, descendant cancellation and partial output are tested. PTY interactions, filesystem tracing and canonical process capture generation are not implemented by run_command.
